title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
statement_md: There is an integer array `nums` sorted in ascending order (with distinct values). Prior to being passed to your function, `nums` is possibly rotated at an unknown pivot index. Return the index of `target` if it exists, otherwise -1.
hints: Determine which half is sorted and check if target lies there.
editorial_md:
### Method: Modified Binary Search
- **Time Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(\log N)$
- **Space Complexity**: $\mathcal{O}(1)$
